description_en: Queries the execution results of a command run by calling the RunCommand operation
description_zh: 查询RunCommand接口命令执行结果
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic describe-invocations --instance-ids acp-bj9t2gmys0000 --invocation-id t-4e98eeb50000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInvocations

parameters.description_en: The IDs of the cloud phone instances. A single request can query the execution results for up to 50 instances.
parameters.description_zh: 云手机实例ID列表，一次请求最多查询50个实例的执行结果。
parameters.help_en: The IDs of the cloud phone instances. A single request can query the execution results for up to 50 instances
parameters.help_zh: 云手机实例ID列表，一次请求最多查询50个实例的执行结果
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.description_en: The ID of the command execution. Use this ID and the cloud phone instance ID to query the result of a command execution.
parameters.description_zh: 命令执行ID，根据该ID和云手机实例ID可查询一次命令执行的结果。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the command execution. Use this ID and the cloud phone instance ID to query the result of a command execution
parameters.help_zh: 命令执行ID，根据该ID和云手机实例ID可查询一次命令执行的结果
parameters.name: invocation_id
